label: Haptic Pressure Stylus
description: A high-precision input device used by the paleo-artist to sculpt soft tissue layers over 3D digital bone meshes.

game_mechanics.muscle_attachment_mini_game: Player must identify 'rugosity' (rough patches on the bone) where tendons once attached. Highlighting the correct spots allows Elena to 'shrink-wrap' the muscles accurately.
game_mechanics.color_theory: Player chooses pigments based on the 'Isotope Map' (e.g., Forest Green for upland herbivores, Sandy Yellow for delta-dwellers).
